adjudication.evidence: Original N/E/U show a sustained ~12-day offset starting near index 540 (E jumps ~20 mm, N ~-7.5 mm, U ~-8.7 mm) and returning near index 545 (E drops back, N/U recover). P1 (533–545) starts too early; P2 is a single-point artifact; P3 (540–587) extends far beyond the return at ~545 and overlaps with later permanent step at 588; P4 (575–587) lies entirely within the post-return noisy baseline and shows only small offsets inconsistent with a platform; P5 (588) coincides with an independent permanent step, not a return. Only one genuine temporary platform exists: onset ~540, return ~545, supported by coherent multi-axis shift and recovery in original observations. No other candidate pair matches both boundaries and interior behavior.
